preparations.title: Lentil curry with potatoes and spinach
preparations.method: On the hob, soften the onions in oil, add curry powder, potatoes, courgettes, tomatoes and water, then simmer until tender. Stir in the lentils and spinach at the end. Cool promptly and weigh four named equal ready-food boxes, keeping each box refrigerated.

preparations.title: Chickpea stew with courgettes and peppers
preparations.method: Soften onions and peppers in oil on the hob. Add paprika, potatoes, courgettes, tomatoes and water, simmer until tender, then fold in chickpeas. Cool promptly and weigh four named equal ready-food boxes, keeping each box refrigerated.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Chop onions, potatoes and courgettes while the hob heats. Soften the onions, add the spices and vegetables, then simmer while washing boxes. Stir in lentils and spinach, cool promptly, and weigh the four named boxes. Keep the batch for Wednesday through Friday only.
